blocks.content: The TCL commands allow us to save changes made in a database and roll back to our previous save point if needed.
Some commonly used TCL commands include:

items: SAVEPOINT - for temporarily storing changes performed by DML (INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE statements)
COMMIT - for permanently storing changes performed by DML (INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE statements)

blocks.content: Recommendation: We suggest you look into DCL and TCL once you are comfortable with other commands.
